section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section reviews the literature on body image, body appreciation, shame, and self-compassion. It establishes the theoretical foundation for a study examining the relationship between body appreciation and variables including body mass index, shame, and self-compassion in a sample of young male and female adults. The study aims to test whether self-compassion mediates the association between external shame and body appreciation, and to analyze sex differences in these associations.
